record.one_liner: Ecommerce platform whose store data (products, orders, customers, categories) is reachable through a REST API.
record.auth_notes: Custom apps use a non-expiring secret access token (api_key style Bearer token). Public/distributed apps use an OAuth-style authorization_code exchange.
record.access_notes: API needs a paid store plan, but Ecwid offers a free upgrade to a paid plan for developers who meet listed criteria (customization project, safe-environment integration, public app development). Criteria are conditional, so confidence is medium.
record.api_notes: Breadth judgement from the REST API overview and order endpoint listings seen in search results; the overview page itself was not fetched.
record.blocker_notes: Custom app tokens are self-serve on a paid or upgraded store. Public app distribution needs a partner contract, which is outside building an agent toolkit.

evidence.quote: Access tokens also do not expire, so once you get them for your custom app, save and use these tokens on your side for as long as you need.
